body.fallback: Draft synthetic venue comparison; supplied facts are unverified. This separate view reads the exact bound saved table and does not change or accept it. Original saved assessments were made against hire cost at most £300 GBP, capacity at least 70 people, and required step-free access, as explicitly recorded in the original human brief. These static assessments and original human notes remain unchanged. Temporary/current filter: budget initially £300, with £350 also available; capacity at least 70 people and step-free access required. “Matches current filter” is a separate local calculation from the saved facts, not a revised assessment. A venue may match at £350 while its original £300 assessment still says it does not qualify; the budgets differ, so this is not contradictory. Open the bound saved table to read venue facts, travel minutes, assessments and exact notes if the interactive view is unavailable. The view never substitutes copied venue data. Refresh saved data reads only the declared exact revision; a refused or stale read is shown as an error, not a successful refresh. Filters are temporary; no edits, discounts, bookings, acceptance or independent verification are performed.

source.html:
Draft fictional venue comparison

Unverified synthetic planning data. A separate, read-only presentation of the saved table; no booking, discount, acceptance or automatic saving.

Original saved-assessment criteria

Hire cost at most £300 GBP · Capacity at least 70 people · Step-free access required.

These criteria are explicitly recorded in the original human brief. Saved assessments and human notes are static and unchanged by this view.

Temporary/current filters

Minimum capacity: 70 people. Step-free access: required.

Filters affect only this temporary view and its local match status. At £350 a venue may match the current filter while its saved assessment still says it does not qualify against £300. Different budgets explain this; the original assessment has not changed.

Waiting for saved data; no matches calculated yet.

Matches current filter

Unknown until the saved table is read.

Matching venues appear first below, followed by other venues for comparison. Missing facts remain unknown.

Original saved table notes and provenance

Refresh reads the exact authorized saved revision, not a latest replacement. A new revision requires an explicit human rebind. Durable changes belong in trusted human-save/proposal controls, not this view.
